findings.details: All available comparisons favor separated Ag.
Measured at 350 eV using fixed MACE-relaxed geometries.
Dense-grid plane-wave cutoff convergence has not been established.
DFT evaluated MACE-relaxed geometries; atomic positions were not DFT-optimized.
Clean-slab stability alone cannot establish CO2-to-ethylene selectivity or Faradaic efficiency.

supported_conclusion: The separated Ag configuration has lower calculated energy across the tested clean-slab model comparisons.
unsupported_conclusions: SEP is globally the most stable configuration.
SEP is more active for CO2 reduction.
The DFT reference is fully converged.
recommended_next_action: Integrate provisional computational evidence into candidate review, while prioritizing reaction-relevant descriptors and uncertainty.
